result.title: Plausible Is Not Proven: Testing Failure Explanations in Monocular Depth Estimation
result.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Code, ratings and results: https://github.com/Md-Zeeshan-Ali/vision-error-observatory
result.summary: Failure analyses of monocular depth models often name a cause for each error, such as an occluding boundary, a thin object or a reflective surface, but such labels are rarely tested. We present the Vision Error Observatory (VEO), an audit that finds regions failing the $δ_1$ criterion on sensor-measured pixels, labels each with a likely cause or abstains, and then subjects the labels to four tests: agreement with object annotations on data the label model never saw, agreement with blinded human raters, response to targeted image edits, and value as a training signal. We apply it to eight models on NYU Depth V2, DIODE and iBims-1, with labels also checked on Hypersim, and fix most decision rules before their results. The occluding-boundary label agrees with annotations (AUROC 0.85 on NYU, 0.81 on Hypersim, 0.69 on iBims-1), but a single depth-edge cue does as well, and most boundary failures of the strongest model vanish under a 2-pixel tolerance. The reflection label does not transfer to synthetic data, the textureless label is near chance against annotations, and only one of four edit tests, an exploratory one, supports its label. Evaluated against five blinded raters, VEO's labels matched the human consensus only at chance level (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.05). In addition, an increase in the weight on the diagnosed regions during fine-tuning led to an increase in the error on targeted pixels at every weight tested. The architecture-specific failure fingerprint claimed by an earlier version of this project also failed to replicate across the datasets. Plausible failure explanations, in short, need to be tested before they are trusted; we release the protocol, code, ratings and every result file.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Vision Error Observatory 审计协议，在 NYU Depth V2、DIODE、iBims-1 等数据集上为单目深度模型的失败区域标注「可能原因」，再用标注一致性、盲评人类、定向图像编辑和训练信号四类检验考察这些失败解释是否成立，结果多数标签未通过。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「合理解释须先检验」的失败归因流程、单线索基线对照与编辑式因果检验，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容归因及失败原因诊断提供可借鉴的审计范式，并提示可解释标签与人评仅达随机水位的陷阱。
